episodes.title: The Chosen One!
episodes.summary: Diagnosed with schizophrenia, Owen is the black sheep of the wealthy Milgrim clan. After losing his job, he enrolls in an experimental drug trial.

episodes.title: Windmills
episodes.summary: When her pilfered stash of pills runs out, troubled Annie tries to quit -- but ends up blackmailing her way into the Neberdine study.

episodes.title: Having a Day
episodes.summary: Muramoto notices irregularities in Annie and Owen's data. He questions Owen, who recalls the worst night of his life: his brother's engagement party.

episodes.title: Furs by Sebastian
episodes.summary: After taking the B pill, Annie and Owen find themselves on 1980s Long Island entangled in a strange caper involving a lemur.

episodes.title: Exactly Like You
episodes.summary: Annie and Owen are Arlie and Ollie, grifters attending a séance at the mysterious Neberdine mansion in the 1940s.

episodes.title: Larger Structural Issues
episodes.summary: Azumi tells James the whole truth about the study's snags and urges him to call his estranged mother, an esteemed therapist.

episodes.title: Ceci N'est Pas Une Drill
episodes.summary: Owen and Annie take the C pill. No longer connected, he belongs to a Mafia family, and she's a medieval guide hired by an ailing elf princess.

episodes.title: The Lake of the Clouds
episodes.summary: Annia and Ellia continue their quest, and Owen's mafioso father pressures him to protect the family. Greta counsels a bereaved Gertie.

episodes.title: Utangátta
episodes.summary: Owen and Annie meet again as a disgraced Icelandic spy and a CIA operative who helps him. Greta implores James to shut down the trial.

episodes.title: Option C
episodes.summary: After the subjects are discharged, James and Azumi face Neberdine's CEO. Owen and Annie part ways -- until a startling headline sparks a reunion.
